scope: Mission Control reasoning Chat -> native ChatGPT Work -> Mission Control reasoning return
owner_outcome: Automate Chat to native ChatGPT Work and Work completion back to the original Mission Control reasoning supervisor so the owner is not used as a clipboard transport.

requirements.text: A native Work execution directive must carry an explicit machine-readable execution surface. The automatic Codex dispatcher must ignore CHATGPT_WORK_CLOUD directives, and Mission Control must not infer Work from a title or prose.

A current source-bound admitted CHATGPT_WORK_CLOUD directive must automatically derive and invoke the canonical direct native Work controller from durable Mission Control state. The owner must not create a request JSON or paste the directive into Work.

Automatic launch preserves deterministic Work title, exact originating Chat title and conversation locator, exact source-bound directive/prompt identity, current native-surface verification, and any irreducible product Accept gate.

Dispatch identity is deterministic over worker, directive id/revision, task, exact directive/source binding and exact bounded prompt. A persisted request with no durable app-boundary handoff intent is mechanically unsent and may resume. Once handoff intent exists, missing outcome is ambiguous and automatic replay is prohibited unless exact proven-unsent evidence is added later.
A Work task waiting for setup, approval, execution, completion receipt, or ambiguity resolution must not starve unrelated eligible Mission Control execution routes.

Work COMPLETED/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/FAILED facts must return to Mission Control automatically through a privacy-safe machine receipt without owner relay. Accepted completion creates exactly one fresh source-bound V6 reasoning-review route to the original stable supervisor and current owner outcome.

The machine receipt may contain only control-plane identity/status facts, check counts, blocker codes, and artifact SHA-256 values. It must not publish prompts, private source text, credentials, absolute private filesystem paths, raw logs, or model reasoning.
Work supplies execution facts only. The original reasoning supervisor decides adequacy, methodology, strategy, owner-outcome satisfaction, and the next consequential action.
Current direct app-executor VERIFIED_NATIVE_WORK evidence remains authoritative. Do not downgrade direct verification to stale supervisor-mediated SOURCE_ATTESTED_NATIVE_WORK semantics.

integration_constraints: Do not merge or cherry-pick chat/mission-control-native-work-autodispatch-20260919 wholesale.
Prefer the current chatgpt-work-cloud-controller.ts and its authenticated app-server/product bridge.
Preserve current request-binding v6, fleet-supervisor, controller-watchdog, issue-178 recovery and Work-thread recovery semantics.
No production deployment is authorized by this requirement.
